pr_body:
Both threads, 4 and the main thread (test_thread_join) where
joining thread5. If thread 4 is scheduled before the
main thread it will be dead before the main thread
had chance to join it. Adding a delay (following the test
pattern) to avoid this problem.

Fixes #25507

@ceolin can you address the comments from Andrew?
